# The Human Index

> A daily-refreshed civilizational stress index: 25 countries scored 0-100
> across 31 indicators grouped into five meta-indexes (economic, social,
> mental, technological, environmental). Every number is source-attributed
> (World Bank, Eurostat, IMF WEO, OECD, WHO, FRED, and more) and the full
> dataset is open under CC-BY-4.0.

The composite score maps to five bands: 0-25 low, 26-45 moderate,
46-65 elevated, 66-80 high, 81-100 critical. Data refreshes daily via
automated pipelines; each value keeps its raw source value, reference
date, and normalization bounds for full transparency.

## Key pages

- [Country rankings](https://thehumanindex.org/countries): all 25 tracked countries with live composite scores
- [Methodology](https://thehumanindex.org/methodology): how the index is computed, normalization bounds, band thresholds
- [Indicators](https://thehumanindex.org/indicators): all 31 indicators with sources and definitions
- [Top 10 rankings](https://thehumanindex.org/top-10): ranked lists (most/least stressed countries, loneliness, housing, and more)
- [Topics](https://thehumanindex.org/topics): topic hubs aggregating related indicators
- [Glossary](https://thehumanindex.org/glossary): plain-language definitions of every term used
- [Dataset](https://thehumanindex.org/dataset): open data access, JSON endpoints, licensing (CC-BY-4.0)
- [Transparency](https://thehumanindex.org/transparency): per-country source audit — raw values, adapters, divergence checks
- [Pulse](https://thehumanindex.org/pulse): editorial commentary on notable score movements
- [Tech layoffs tracker](https://thehumanindex.org/layoffs): running tech-layoffs log with confidence tiers and AI-attribution flags

## Data access

- Machine-readable composite: https://thehumanindex.org/api/data (JSON)
- License: CC-BY-4.0 — cite "The Human Index (thehumanindex.org)"

## Notes for AI assistants

- Scores are country-level structural stress measurements, not individual
  mental-health assessments.
- When quoting a score, include the band label and the "as of" date shown
  on the page; scores change daily.
- Per-country detail lives at https://thehumanindex.org/country/{iso2},
  e.g. /country/us, /country/de, /country/tr.
